FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 157 as introduced could increase the obligations of state and local law enforcement
agencies, by an undetermined amount, to comply with the provisions of this bill regarding
litigation in circuit court when the release of a body-worn camera recording is denied by a law
enforcement agency. The increased obligations of law enforcement agencies could be offset,
partly by any fees charged and collected for the production, editing and/or redaction of a
recording as provided by this bill.
